cause: Task catalogue and ancestry used the native collapsed display transcript. The nested Task still existed in the native active branch but was omitted before host task projection.
changes: Use public native file loader, in-memory migrator and SessionEntryIndex to recover task declarations from the complete selected child branch, including pre-compaction messages.
Keep task detail on native collapsed display transcript; never replay hidden history to the model, open a child writer, revive or prompt.
Validate native headers, malformed records, duplicate IDs, real paths and file identity before/after the two read-only views; invalidate cached metadata on file change.
Clone derived cached task rows before scanning to avoid stale ancestry mutation across scans.
Add native regression to default smoke (121 entries) and six source/packaged desktop gates. Workflows not executed.
coverage: Actual three-task nested execution, public native compaction after writers close, restoration in fresh host with all three completed tasks.
Repeated child compaction and compaction in both parent/child preserve task catalogue and native collapsed details.
Native child branch switch hides abandoned nested task, restoring branch recovers it; no all-file branch leakage.
Same host cache sees native child branch changes; removed history handle rejected, restored task gets a new handle.
Nested output reader resolves original tool result through compacted ancestry.
Every read leaves all transcript byte hashes unchanged and causes zero model calls; parent close may append only native session_exit metadata, all child bytes unchanged.
